## Workload

Lena Fischer completed 739 reads during 354 hours of grading activity. This represents an average of 2.1 reads per hour. The workload record provides a clear summary of the volume completed and the time allocated to the work. It also supports comparison of the recorded activity with the expected session pattern, without requiring any adjustment to the reported figures.

The workload information was reviewed as part of the quality assessment. The figures are presented as recorded for the period under review and retain the reported distinction between total reads and hours worked.

## Quality

A total of 57 reads were checked as part of the review. The recorded agreement level was 75.4 per cent. This provides the quality measure for the work completed by Lena Fischer and should be considered alongside the workload information above.

Priya Anand reviewed the grading record and the checked reads. The review confirms the reported workload and quality figures as provided.
